title: A Novel Batch Normalization Approach Inspired by Harsanyi’s Aggregation Theorem with Dynamic Feature Attention
content: With the continuous development of neural network structures, batch normalization, as a standardization technique, has been widely used in various deep learning models to accelerate convergence and improve model stability. This paper proposes a novel mechanism: introducing the idea of Harsanyi aggregation theorem into batch normalization, constructing a normalization method with attention regulation, so that the model has stronger expressiveness and adaptability when processing feature normalization. This method has not only achieved preliminary verification results in multi-layer perceptrons (MLP), but also has the potential to be promoted in other architectures (such as CNN, Transformer, etc.).
